parameters.title: The row's name.
parameters.subtitle: A second line.
parameters.leading: A glyph at the row's start.
parameters.trailing: A control at the row's end (a switch, a stepper).
parameters.trailingText: A value at the row's end.
parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.selected: Indicates whether the item is selected.
parameters.showChevron: Controls the directional indicator at the end of the row.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Applies the destructive treatment to the row.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says, when not the row's words.
parameters.style: This row's own style, over GlossThemeData.listTileStyle.
